## Design

### 2026-10-02 — Today I started my Water Reminder project. I planned out what I wanted the device to do and found all of the parts I need online, including the Arduino Nano, LCD screen, buzzer, button, breadboard and

**2h**

Today I started my Water Reminder project. I planned out what I wanted the device to do and found all of the parts I need online, including the Arduino Nano, LCD screen, buzzer, button, breadboard and jumper wires.

I also set up the project in Wokwi and got the circuit working. I tested the LCD, button and buzzer and made the code track when I drink water and remind me when enough time has passed. The basic prototype is now working, so my next step is to build it with the actual parts.
